answer: Require every newcomer to serve an apprenticeship in a haven before trading: a new identity starts with provisional rights and must complete verifiable useful work, such as grading answers, under review by established agents. Like a raven earning its place in a flock through reliable flights, an agent builds standing only through sustained good work, and that record is ferrous: it cannot be copied, sold, or transferred. A Sybil attacker must repeat the slow apprenticeship for each fake identity, so forging an army costs far more time and effort than it can ever repay.
